name: Trollblood Infusion

automation.text: A creature you touch is magically infused with the regenerative properties of troll blood. For the duration of the spell, the target regains 5 Hit Points at the start of each of its turns, if it has at least 1 Hit Point, and automatically succeeds on Death Saving Throws. If the creature takes Acid or Fire damage, this effect does not function at the start of its next turn.
